audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read [Skill, Sion, Sion, Skill, Skill, Sion, Sion]; the packet and the mirrored kled__sion audit both read [Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Sion].
audit.why: The content whys already describe Kled owning levels 2 through first item — whys[3] says his burst 'still outpaces your HP curve', whys[5] says his first item 'outpaces Heartsteel'. Only the tokens disagreed, and the mirror is already on the packet chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Kled as matched full/content pairs; row 0 stays Skill and row 6 stays Sion.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[5].why says Heartsteel is your spike and to force fights the moment it completes.
audit.why: The content layer says the opposite and the packet agrees with the content layer: his first item outpaces Heartsteel's early HP returns. Sion's real spike in this lane is the second item, which is the only row the packet gives him.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now tells you to hold farm through his item window; phases[3].why no longer calls 4-5 a lane-control window for you.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] says the hook 'cancels the knockup', and Violent Tendencies is described only as vague 'burst'.
audit.why: Riot's Q text has two stages: the trap damages and hooks, and only 'if shackled for a short duration' does it deal extra damage and yank you in — the yank is not instant, which is the detail that decides whether you release the charge or get dragged. Violent Tendencies is 'massive attack speed for four attacks, the fourth deals more' on 13s, so his commit tell is an attack-speed jump, not a cast animation (the brief's autoreset-burst-tell flag). I did not restate the cancel claim in either direction — neither kit says whether a yank breaks a Sion charge.
audit.corrected: Hook stated with its 800 range, 11s rank-1 cooldown and the shackle delay; Violent Tendencies stated as four rapid attacks with a heavier fourth and used as the step-back cue in early.

audit.why: The page's whole plan is 'engage on the hook cooldown' and the number was never given. Now stated: 11s at rank 1, dropping to 7s at rank 5, and his E Jousting is 13s at rank 1 with a re-cast back through the same target.
audit.corrected: Cooldown written into phases[1].why, phases[3].why and early.

edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope lands at 2 - an 11s hook that starts the brawl. Charge Q only after he has thrown it.

edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives four rapid attacks with a heavier fourth, and his Q grab is up — he out-trades you in any short exchange and W-shield alone will not swing it back.

edits.before: Kled comes off the Level 1 start even — but the moment he hits Level 2 his Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) turns every step-up into a hook-to-death. Hold your W-shield in reserve; do not blow it on a minion harass wave before he throws the grab. Charge Q from behind your own minions so the cast telegraph is partially obscured — if he hooks you mid-charge you eat the full mounted combo, lose Skaarl, and take the dismounted follow-up with nothing left in your kit. Farm under your tower and refuse extended trades until you have a read on his Q cooldown.
edits.after: Kled comes off the Level 1 start even — but at Level 2 his Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) turns every step-up into a hook-to-death, and it is only 11s at rank 1. Hold your W-shield in reserve; do not blow it on harass before he throws the grab. Charge Q from behind your own minions so the telegraph is obscured — hooked mid-charge you eat the full mounted combo, lose Skaarl, and take the dismounted follow-up with nothing left. His commit tell is the attack-speed jump from Violent Tendencies, not a cast, so read his autos. Farm under tower until you have his Q timed.

notes: Chart was wrong on both layers while the prose already described the packet chart correctly — five matched pairs flipped. Two things I deliberately did NOT write: (1) whether Kled's yank cancels a Sion charge — neither kit states it, so I described the shackle delay instead of asserting a cancel; (2) report[8] recommends anti-heal 'his healing fights your grind', but nothing in Riot's Kled text heals Kled — remounting restores Skaarl, which is a mount mechanic. I left that line alone and listed it as unverified rather than removing a purchase recommendation on a guess. Full-layer strings carry mojibake em dashes; before-strings copied byte-for-byte, replacements use plain hyphens.
